samplingOptions.title: Advanced sampling options
samplingOptions.description: These parameters override the model defaults for the next message send. They are stored in this browser only and are not persisted per-conversation.
samplingOptions.temperatureDescription: Controls randomness. Lower values are more deterministic; higher values are more creative.
samplingOptions.topPDescription: Nucleus sampling threshold. Only tokens whose cumulative probability reaches this value are considered.
samplingOptions.topKDescription: Limits sampling to the top K most likely tokens.
samplingOptions.minPDescription: Minimum probability for a token to be considered relative to the most probable token.
samplingOptions.repeatPenaltyDescription: Penalizes repetition. Values above 1 discourage the model from repeating itself.
samplingOptions.repeatLastNDescription: Number of tokens to look back when applying the repeat penalty. -1 uses the full context.
samplingOptions.presencePenaltyDescription: Penalizes tokens that have already appeared in the output, regardless of frequency.
samplingOptions.frequencyPenaltyDescription: Penalizes tokens proportionally to how often they have already appeared in the output.
samplingOptions.maxOutputTokensDescription: Maximum number of tokens to generate. Clamped to the model context length when set.
samplingOptions.seedDescription: Random seed for reproducibility. -1 uses a random seed.
samplingOptions.numCtxDescription: Size of the context window in tokens used to generate the next token.
samplingOptions.stopDescription: One stop sequence per line. The model halts when it emits any of these strings.

welcome.title: Welcome — let's get you to your first answer
welcome.body: This node has no chat model yet, so it can't reply until you install one. Take a short guided tour: install a recommended chat model, make it the default, then send your first message. You can skip any time.

navModels.title: Find your models here
navModels.content: Open the Models section. This is where you discover, install, and manage the local models that power chat.

recommendationInstall.title: Install a recommended chat model
recommendationInstall.content: Pick a recommended chat model and start its download — installing one moves the tour on automatically. No model yet? Just click Next to continue.

setDefaultModel.title: Make it your default
setDefaultModel.content: Set your installed chat model as the default so new conversations use it automatically. Setting a default moves the tour on, or click Next to continue.

navChat.title: Open Chat
navChat.content: Now head to the Chat section to talk to your model.

chatInput.title: Type your first message
chatInput.content: Enter anything you'd like to ask — for example, "Hello, can you introduce yourself?"

chatSend.title: Send it
chatSend.content: Send your message. The model will start generating a reply.

firstResponse.title: Your first answer
firstResponse.content: The assistant's response streams in here. That's it — you're up and running. Ask anything next.

reasoningEffort.title: Adjustable reasoning depth
reasoningEffort.content: When you use a reasoning-capable model, a low / medium / high control appears here. Higher effort gives more thorough answers at the cost of extra time.

reasoningTrace.title: See the model think
reasoningTrace.content: When a reasoning-capable model is active, its internal thinking process appears in a collapsible block before the answer — so you can follow its logic.

toolCall.title: Tool calls in context
toolCall.content: Agent-capable models can call tools (search, code execution, and more). Each call shows the tool name, the arguments, and the result right in the conversation.

agentMode.title: Specialized agents
agentMode.content: Switch from Default Assistant to a specialized agent persona — each one is tuned with a different system prompt and skill set for specific tasks.

notes.offline: You appear to be offline. Model discovery needs an internet connection — you can skip the tour and try again later.
notes.emptyRecommendations: No installable models were returned. You can skip the tour and revisit Recommendations once models are available.

reasoningEffort.label: Reasoning effort
reasoningEffort.description: When you use a reasoning-capable model, this control sets how hard it thinks before replying.

reasoningTrace.label: Thinking
reasoningTrace.sample: Let me break this down step by step. First, I should consider the constraints…
reasoningTrace.description: The model's internal reasoning appears here before the final answer — only on reasoning-capable models.

toolCall.label: Tool call
toolCall.sample:
search_web({ query: "latest llama.cpp release" })
→ Result: "b4567 released 2 days ago…"
toolCall.description: When an agent-capable model uses a tool, the call and its result appear inline like this.

agentMode.label: Agent mode
agentMode.description: Pick a specialized agent persona from the selector in the chat toolbar to change the model's focus and instructions.
